notes: V7.1.3: updates are now notify-only. APEX no longer auto-applies an install — it just shows an UPDATE AVAILABLE banner in the top-right header when a new version exists, and you click to start the install. The installer's normal UI is shown (no silent install) so SmartScreen / Defender prompts are handled correctly. Also includes a Check for updates now button in Tools. This fixes the auto-update loop reported in v1.1.0 -> v1.1.2.
